-- class: expand

-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "public"."countries" (
  "id" uuid not null,
  "name" text not null,
  constraint "countries_pkey" primary key ("id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "public"."notes" (
  "id" uuid not null,
  "tenant_id" uuid not null,
  "title" text not null,
  constraint "notes_pkey" primary key ("id", "tenant_id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: add-constraint
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."notes" add constraint "notes_id_tenant_id_key" unique ("id", "tenant_id");

-- class: expand
-- kind: enable-rls
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."notes" enable row level security;

-- class: expand
-- kind: enable-rls
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."notes" force row level security;

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-policy
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create policy "notes_tenant" on "public"."notes" as permissive for all using (tenant_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) with check (tenant_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid);

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-policy
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create policy "notes_unscoped_select" on "public"."notes" as permissive for select using (current_setting('app.unscoped'::text, true) = 'on'::text);

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-view
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create view "public"."open_notes" with (security_invoker = true) as select id, tenant_id from notes;
